note: Clark County park on the north shore of Mead Lake, the county's second-largest lake, off North Lake Road in the Town of Mead, with a small swimming beach and a boat landing. ATVs and UTVs are not allowed. --Claude
summary: County park page, county camping-fee page and campground map read; imagery checked. Fees $24-35 (+$3 weekends/holidays, $10 reservation fee) confirmed; 76 sites (1-71, A-E), 9 without electric; showers/flush/vault/dump/water; reservable May 1-Sep 30 via WebTrac (refuses, unread), self-registration otherwise -> year_round with note. PIN MOVE ~600 m: stored point is on the south shore, campground is on the north shore. Lakefront -> lakeview recommended (lake-side sites 35-39 sit behind a shoreline tree belt).
